name: nettopo
description: Single-file, offline network configuration & flow analyzer for IT and OT environments.

scripts.test:engine: for f in tests/engine/reach-test*.js; do echo "== $f =="; node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:browser: for f in tests/browser/e2e.js tests/browser/e2e-sec.js tests/browser/e2e-audit.js tests/browser/e2e-route.js tests/browser/fgtest.js tests/browser/mhtest.js tests/browser/mxcip-test.js tests/browser/reachui-test.js tests/browser/reach-bind-test.js tests/browser/nat-test.js tests/browser/vend-test.js tests/browser/intent-test.js tests/browser/ot-test.js tests/browser/ot2-test.js; do echo "== $f =="; ./tests/runtest.sh "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:engine && npm run test:browser
